12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.

Built **Ashen Oath**, a complete turn-based RPG playable on phones and tablets. Choose a Knight, Mage, or Ranger, then battle through five increasingly difficult encounters to face the Cinder Wyrm. Combat includes class skills, enemy intent, guarding, healing potions, focus, XP, and level-ups.

Run locally with `python3 -m http.server 3002` and open `http://localhost:3002`. I checked the game in a browser at desktop and mobile sizes, and verified `game.js` syntax. Assumptions: a short five-encounter run, solo play, and a D&D-inspired fantasy feel.
